flagged.title: The Trinity and the Nicene Creed
flagged.reason: The video omits the mandatory specification keyword 'consubstantial' and instead tells students the Creed declares the Son is 'of one substance with the Father' (F2), which would cost marks on exam questions testing Nicene Creed terminology.

mark_affecting.quote: Homoousios: Of one substance with the Father... When the creed declares that the Son is of one substance with the Father
